subs.note: Cristóbal de Morales. The movements of the mass, each on its own.

items.title: Kyrie (Morales, Missa Benedicta es)
items.desc: Cristóbal de Morales, Missa Benedicta es, Kyrie, 1551. 4 voices (Cantus, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.

Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
